researchedExamples.correction: Prominent forward-curving crest, black forehead/throat, large white cheek patch, brown upperparts, pale underparts and yellow vent. Do not substitute the weakly crested White-eared Bulbul.
Use an adult black-headed morph, with entirely dark head/crest and orange-red bill and legs. Body tone can vary by subspecies. Do not use a white-headed morph for this requested repair.

Adult plumage: pale sandy/creamy head, dark brown body and wings, broad black tail crossed by a conspicuous broad white band. Do not use the unbanded juvenile tail or an entirely white sea-eagle tail.

Dark slate-grey pigeon with pink/purple breast and subdued neck gloss; darker flight feathers and grey tail with dark terminal band. No white neck patch or white tail as in other pigeons. Avoid a pale generic wood pigeon.
Predominantly uniform warm/rufous brown, wings and rounded tail slightly darker, vent grading grey-brown. Fine slightly curved bill; no invented stripes or bright red vent.
